targetCompanyImage.name: Abbotsford Regional Hospital and Cancer Centre
targetCompanyImage.description: Abbotsford Regional Hospital and Cancer Centre is a hospital PPP asset serving Fraser Valley patients through acute care and cancer services. The facility serves the Fraser Health region and related public healthcare users rather than private-pay markets. Its operating model is asset-heavy and availability-based, with long-term public-sector service payments characteristic of hospital PPP structures. Public sources describe the campus as a roughly 300-bed, approximately 645,000-square-foot facility in Abbotsford, British Columbia. The reviewed materials did not disclose current project-level revenue or equity ownership percentages. The investment is associated with Jura Acquisition, the vehicle backed by funds managed by Equitix and Dalmore following the 2018 take-private of John Laing Infrastructure Fund, and exact project-level ownership percentages were not publicly disclosed.

milestones.event: Financial close was completed for the hospital PPP project.
The hospital opened and began serving the Fraser Valley region.
John Laing Infrastructure Fund's scheme of arrangement became effective, taking the portfolio private through Jura Acquisition, a vehicle backed by Equitix and Dalmore-managed funds.
